ph1101a.title: Winnie the Pooh Disney 100 Years Platinum Tumbler with Straw Jump into Colors
ph1101a.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
ph1101a.details: SEGA prize item from the Disney Winnie the Pooh 100 Years series: the Platinum Zakka tumbler with straw, Jump into Colors, a Namco-limited release. The series has two designs, and the design in this box is the one checked on the front of the box: Pooh, Tigger, Piglet and Lumpy jumping among flowers. The set is a tumbler with a lid, a straw and a silicone seal. Condition: brand new and unopened, in the original box; the contents were not checked because the box is sealed. The box has light shelf wear and a few creases, as shown in the photos. Not for microwave use. Please see the photos for the box condition.
